newsitem.title: USA: HCC Insurance buys Managed Group Underwriting.
newsitem.headline: HCC Insurance buys Managed Group Underwriting.

text.p: HCC Insurance Holdings Inc said that it agreed in principle to acquire all of the outstanding shares of Managed Group Underwriting Inc in exchange for cash and shares of HCCH's common stock.
The acquisition is subject to definitive agreements and is expected to close by the end of June, a statement issued by HCC said.

Managed Group Underwriting is a managing general underwriter located in Kansas City, Mo., underwriting medical stop loss insurance throughout the United States, specializing in employer sponsored, self-insured health plans with employee populations ranging in size from 25 to 10,000, HCC said.
Sandra Ruder, founder, will remain chief executive following the acquisition, HCC said.
